title: Craftable Tridents by HexaFoxx
description: Craftable Tridents was made so we don't have to grind, kill and repeat, Craftable Tridents is an amazing plugin allowing YOU to craft a trident.
body:
Craftable Tridents adds a balanced and immersive way to obtain tridents without relying on rare drowned drops.

Instead of grinding endlessly, you can now craft your own trident using valuable materials. The recipe is designed to feel fair while still keeping the trident a powerful late-game item.

  Features
Adds a custom trident crafting recipe
Uses high-tier materials for balanced gameplay
Automatically supports both Blaze Rod and Breeze Rod depending on your Minecraft version
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Works on modern Spigot/Paper servers
